hypothesis: H6: when no teacher exists, an agent can devise its own microtasks by restarting practice from moments of its remembered best episodes — an online top-10 episodic memory turns 'my best games' into a start-state drill distribution. Self-drills should reach full-game mastery faster than whole-game practice (claim 1) and are compared head-to-head with EXP2's teacher-designed drills (claim 2: match, or quantify the value of expert curriculum design); the annealed variant probes schedule sensitivity.

config.teacher_protocol: EXP2 drills-varied and whole, imported from exp2_microtask.py (bit-identical reruns of EXP2's shipped arms)
config.eval_protocol: 20 greedy kickoff episodes every 2000 steps on a separate env/rng (default_rng([seed, step])); excluded from all budgets

tests.correction: holm-bonferroni over the 2-comparison primary family (MW and Welch families adjusted separately); verdicts count both statistics per DESIGN.md v3

claims.claim: an agent can devise useful drills from its own episodic memory: self-drills (restarts from remembered best-episode moments) reaches 90% full-game eval success in fewer env steps than whole-game practice
claims.evidence: t90 IQM self-drills=29000 vs whole=40375 steps; MW p_holm=0.0212, Welch p_holm=0.0199; censored self-drills 2/30, whole 6/30.

claims.claim: self-devised drills match teacher-designed drills (t90 within a pre-registered +20% margin; direction reported either way)
claims.evidence: t90 IQM self-drills=29000 vs teacher-drills=15125 steps; MW p_holm=2.9e-07, Welch p_holm=2.53e-06; censored self-drills 2/30, teacher-drills 0/30. Expert curriculum design is worth 13875 steps (92% of teacher t90): the teacher is detectably faster and the gap exceeds the margin (gap CI95 [9125, 19500] steps vs margin +3025 (+20% of teacher t90)).

conclusion.summary: Time to 90% eval success (IQM steps): whole=40375, teacher-drills=15125, self-drills=29000, self-drills-late=28750. self-drills vs whole: MW p_holm=0.0212, Welch p_holm=0.0199; self-drills vs teacher-drills: MW p_holm=2.9e-07, Welch p_holm=2.53e-06, gap CI95 [9125, 19500] vs margin +3025. Verdicts: claim 1 (self-drills beat whole) — supported; claim 2 (self matches teacher) — refuted. Censored: whole 6/30, teacher-drills 0/30, self-drills 2/30, self-drills-late 2/30.
